section_summary.extract_value: This Results section reports analyses from a single study (N=509) examining relationships between drive for muscularity, body appreciation, personality traits (Big Five), and BMI. Body appreciation was found to be significantly and negatively correlated with both Neuroticism and BMI, while hierarchical regression analyses revealed Neuroticism and BMI as significant predictors in the drive for muscularity model, and Neuroticism, subjective social status, BMI, and Extraversion as significant predictors in the body appreciation model.

section_summary.extract_value: This Results section presents descriptive statistics and bivariate correlations for a single study (N = 509) examining relationships between drive for muscularity, body appreciation, personality traits (Big Five), BMI, and subjective social status. Body appreciation was significantly and negatively correlated with BMI (r = -0.12) and Neuroticism, while positively correlated with Extraversion and subjective social status. Hierarchical regression analyses revealed that Neuroticism and BMI were significant predictors of drive for muscularity, while Neuroticism, subjective social status, BMI, and Extraversion were significant predictors of body appreciation.
